name: Design Pricing
description: Pricing plan cards in 10 designs (classic, highlighted, glass, gradient header, minimal, horizontal, checklist, compact, dark enterprise, outline bold). Follows the common SaaS pricing-table pattern: plan, price with currency and period, short pitch, feature checklist and one call to action, with one plan highlighted.
helpText: Use report mode with one row per plan (2 to 4 plans read best). Map Features to a column that joins the features with |, for example Unlimited orders|Priority support. Map Highlight to a column returning Y for the recommended plan. The call to action renders as a native Universal Theme button (hot for the highlighted plan).

attributes.name: Style
attributes.helpText: The pricing design. Every style is a different layout or treatment; colors always come from the active theme style.

attributes.name: Plan
attributes.helpText: Plan name, for example Starter, Business or Enterprise.

attributes.name: Price
attributes.helpText: The amount. Format it in SQL with the application's NLS settings, for example to_char(monthly_fee, 'FML999G990'). Text such as Custom also works.

attributes.name: Currency
attributes.helpText: Currency symbol or code shown before the amount, for example SAR, USD or $. Leave empty for text prices such as Custom.

attributes.name: Period
attributes.helpText: Billing period shown after the amount, for example / month or per user / year.

attributes.name: Description
attributes.helpText: One short sentence about who the plan is for.

attributes.name: Features
attributes.helpText: Features separated by |, for example 5 users|Unlimited orders|Email support. The runtime file turns them into a check list; without JavaScript the plain text is shown.

attributes.name: Button Label
attributes.helpText: Call to action label, for example Start free trial or Contact sales. Leave empty to hide the button.

attributes.name: Button Link
attributes.helpText: Target URL of the call to action, for example f?p=&APP_ID.:20:&SESSION.::NO::P20_PLAN:BUSINESS. Must be a developer-controlled value, never raw user input. Without a link a plain button is rendered for a Dynamic Action.

attributes.name: Badge
attributes.helpText: Optional short badge, for example Most popular or Save 20%.

attributes.name: Highlight
attributes.helpText: Y highlights this plan and makes its button the hot button. Any other value, or empty, renders a normal plan.
